edges.claim: The official East Japan training page lists ChatGPT usage as part of a June 12-13, 2025 generative-AI/machine-learning course restricted to investee companies. It proves a training curriculum, not an OpenAI partnership.

The official West Japan profile identifies Osaka Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC West Japan), and its public seminar material discusses ChatGPT and generative AI. This is separate from East Japan and not evidence of an XRP relationship.

Official profiles describe Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka SME investment/consultation companies as sister companies under the SME Investment & Consultation Companies Act, with different regional coverage. Shared SBIC branding does not make them SBI Crypto or historical SBI Capital.

The reviewed SBIC East/West training and company-profile sources do not establish Ripple partnership, XRP holdings, XRP payment use, custody or investment. This is a bounded absence-of-evidence finding, not proof that no relationship exists elsewhere.

SBI Holdings historically used SBIC for SBI Capital Co., Ltd.; a separate legal complaint uses SBIC for SBI Crypto Co., Ltd.; the regional Japanese SME investment companies also use SBIC in their English branding. Resolve the original referent from its surrounding source, not the acronym alone.

hypotheses.statement: The phrase 'ChatGPT SBIC' may refer to training organized by one of the Japanese regional SBIC SME investment companies.
disconfirming_evidence: The original phrase/context is not supplied in the current evidence; SBI Crypto and historical SBI Capital also have used SBIC in distinct contexts.
tests_needed: Match the original phrase to a dated post, document, video or named entity before resolving intended meaning.

hypotheses.statement: A regional SBIC training page implies an XRP or Ripple relationship.
disconfirming_evidence: The cited training and profile pages describe SME investment/support and generative-AI training, not XRP, Ripple, crypto custody or token investment.
tests_needed: Require a direct official statement, filing or transaction record naming the exact legal entity and XRP/Ripple relationship.

notes: Confirmed: East and West are distinct regional SME investment/consultation companies; both publish ChatGPT/GenAI training materials.
Inference: 'ChatGPT SBIC' could be a reference to one of these courses, but the intended entity is still unresolved.
Unknown: no direct East/West SBIC-to-XRP edge is established in reviewed sources.
Do not conflate these companies with historical SBI Capital Co., Ltd., SBI Crypto Co., Ltd. or SBI Group's Ripple relationships.
